status: System re-frozen after the M2 addendum (WP6 S5b, 2026-10-25), config version 2; replaces the M2 system (results/WP6/m2_system.pkl) for WP7 S2
inputs: per-tick parts per DOMAIN: score (domain combined calibrated tick max), count (samples in the tick), layers / layer_alarm (per-layer scores / own alarms; LiDAR: 4 columns L1, L2a, L2c, L2d), dom_alarm, blame (cross)
lidar_input: frozen lidar/domain.py (results/WP3/S9/frozen_lidar), LidarDomain.stream().push(points, pose, t) per scan; tick = floor(scan time); tick value = max over the scans of the second of the combined score and of every per-layer score; own alarm = any scan alarm in the second (combined / per layer)
v2x_input: VeReMi-calibrated frozen physics stack for the VeReMi view; on REAL V2X (V2AIX) the on-deployment variant (WP5 S3b thresholds fitted on the deployment's own genuine validation + freshness age check) must replace it and the v2x entry ECDF must be re-fitted on that deployment's clean ticks
response_policy: fusion/correlator.py respond(): WARN every event; DEGRADE blamed domain >= 3 blamed ticks; SAFE_STOP (>= 2 motion-critical domains degraded or a motion-critical degrade lasting >= 30 s) AND >= 2 different domains with their own alarm in the event; V2X / network alone never above DEGRADE; event blame = majority_decided
